proposition: Nafsat I argues the accusers are hypocrites because Zamakhsharī's Muʿtazili Kashshāf is universally promoted although its doctrine of a created Quran is deemed kufr by leading Hanafis and Shafiʿis.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to the ruler who was judging him
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
